{{Top|leg}}
The '''K'zagg Colony''' was a settlement of native [[Ruurian/Legends|Ruurians]] that dwelled along the banks of the [[river]] [[Z'gag/Legends|Z'gag]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ruuria/Legends|Ruuria]]. The colony consisted of the [[Larva/Legends|larva]], pupa, and [[Ruurian/Legends|chroma-wing]] stages of the Ruurian species.

[[S. V. Skynx/Legends|Skynx]], the academician, was an inhabitant of the K'zagg Colony, prior to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].
